title: 有馬記念の後に・Das Versprechen

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she doesn't win, Eishin Flash becomes the center of the older racers' attention and feels confident about beginning her senior year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just when Eishin Flash realizes that completing her schedule is within the realm of possibility, she receives a message from her parents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They tell her they're planning to visit Japan to see her race in person. She is overjoyed by the news and vows to win every race leading up to their visit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho becomes her ultimate goal since that's when her parents will be in Japan. But first, there's the Osaka Hai to contend with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, I can't help but feel unnerved by how many established racers are returning to the scene to race in the G1 races…
